notes.title: Harem of Valerius Development Update: New Steps in Episode 3!
notes.notes:
I'm back with new updates! Here are the latest developments:

🎭 Character Updates
Elpis and Thetis are now in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/b6a42423d5557c0b92e7f7340fb6903678d17196.png[/img]
Their models and special outfits have been successfully added.

The characters now fully blend into the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/ffc95687501acd22e5f15accd34fd136ec56af8c.png[/img]

💃 Brothel Mechanics Improvements
Bugs in cutscenes have been fixed.

Romance sequences are now smoother and more seamless.
Note : I will fix the hair shaders

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/3cd16e2b23baef90de1e07d67a3fa231e47080f7.png[/img]


🏙️ Revitalized City Atmosphere
New NPC animations have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/9efcd7c73437d874463d7f0f94f585369db4ab14.png[/img]

The streets now feel more dynamic and alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/054d7102cfcb791185b69f8fd6ad8b5e07cd6aa7.png[/img]



🔮 Next Goal: Thetis' Ship & City Management
After completing Thetis' quest:

New city mechanics will be introduced.

Randomized quests will unlock through Thetis' ship.

Manage the ship to gather resources and strengthen your city.

If you show her enough attention, surprise rewards await you! 😊

Please don't forget to add your wishlist ; https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714590/Harem_Of_Valerius

Thank you

notes.title: A Spartan’s Journey Begins: Welcome to Valerius’ World!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello warriors,[/h2]

I’m thrilled to finally share Harem of Valerius with you on Steam—a passion project born in December 2024 and crafted entirely by my hands. As a solo developer, every line of code, every animation, and every tangled myth in this game carries a piece of my heart. ❤️

[h2]What Makes This Adventure Unique?[/h2]
⚔️ Genre-Blending Innovation:
For the first time in adult gaming, experience a fusion of side-scroller action, city-building strategy, and narrative-driven romance. Rescue priestesses, rebuild a shattered city, and seduce gods—all while unraveling divine conspiracies.

🔮[h2] Realistic Scope & Vision:[/h2]
Though the journey has just begun (with Episode 1 live and Episode 2 nearing completion), the roadmap is clear:

Handcrafted combat with parries, dashes, and epic boss fights.

Deep village management where choices affect alliances and resources.

Mature storytelling where romance serves the plot, not just fanservice. 

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
Demo Coming Soon! (Wishlist now to get notified 🔔)

Early Access: Targeting Q3 2025, with Patreon supporters gaining early builds.

Your Voice Matters: Feedback will shape future episodes!

[h2]Why Wishlist?[/h2]
Support a solo dev chasing an ambitious dream.

Get instant updates on demo releases and exclusive content.

Help us conquer Steam’s algorithm—every wishlist counts! ⚔️  



[h2]A Personal Note[/h2]
Building this alone has been equal parts chaos and magic. From debugging at 3 AM to rewriting quest systems twice, your support turns exhaustion into purpose. Thank you for believing in a Spartan, his harem, and a kinky lemur’s wild vision. 🐒💫

With grit and gratitude,
Kinky Lemur Games
